root_cause: The source-side Supabase preview contract validated migration filenames and duplicate versions but allowed empty SQL files, so placeholder migrations could mask remote/local migration-history drift.
prevention: Reject empty Supabase migration files in the PR preview contract.
Keep Supabase Preview as a required protected-branch status check.
Require unique timestamped migration versions and non-empty SQL content before merge.
Never use empty placeholder migrations to satisfy remote/local parity.
